violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: several foods on the hot rail were not being held hot enough. A tofu dish was 123°, a broccolini dish was 115°, a pork dish with vegetables was 86° and a sweet-and-sour chicken dish was 98°. Whole chicken in the display case at the end of the hot rail was 75°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. All the foods that were out of the temperature were discarded during the inspection to correct. The AHS explained the time as a public health control procedures to the PIC who said she would adopt those procedures from now on. A TPHC procedure was created during the inspection. YOU YOU & CAO (Inspection Date: 09/08/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: several foods in the walk- in refrigerator were not cold enough. Pork stuffing for steam buns was 45°, steam buns were 43°, raw shell eggs were 46°, tofu was 54°.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The other temperature foods were discarded during the inspection to correct

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Bleach another cleaning supplies were stored on a shelf over the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC move the chemicals during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. An unlabeled sprayer bottle of clear liquid was observed under the three compartment sink. The PIC stated this was a cleaning chemical.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the container during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed several employee, personal care items stored over the food prep area in such a way that they could contaminate food foods being prepared
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. The PIC moved the personal care items during the inspection discontinue storing personal care items over food prep areas or with food or equipment.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: three cases of frozen duck were being thawed at room temperature on the table in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. The EH discussed with the PIC that foods must be thawed by one of the way is shown above and not at room temperature.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Several flies are observed in the kitchen area, especially around the grease trap on the back wall.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who said she would contact the pest control operator to have the establishment treated for flies.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. The back door was propped open, and there was no screen door install installed. If you want to keep the back door open, you must install a screen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. The PIC closed the back door during the inspection to correct YOU YOU & CAO (Inspection Date: 09/08/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the walk-in refrigerator was 44°F in several foods in the unit were out of temperature
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Contact your EHS when the walk-in is adjusted our serviced and keeping foods at the proper temperature.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the interior parts of the hood and the hood filters were visibly soiled with grease and food debris and is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the hood and filters as soon as possible. The hood was scheduled to be cleaned during this week.
